clean_description: Sapiens explores the history of humankind from the emergence of Homo sapiens to modern society. Harari examines how our species evolved, created complex societies, and developed shared beliefs in constructs like money and nations. The book integrates insights from various disciplines to challenge conventional understandings of human behavior and societal development.
themes: evolution, society, belief systems, human behavior
setting: the history of humankind from prehistory to the present
